text:
I’m a passionate and hard-working full-stack freelancer with 7 years of experience building responsive web experiences, and I’d love to help refresh your WordPress e-commerce site quickly and cleanly.

I understand you need someone who can jump in right away to connect a new domain, re-upload product images, and make minor layout tweaks for a fresh look. That’s exactly the kind of focused, practical work I’m comfortable handling. I work across JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST APIs, Tailwind CSS, Stripe, HTML, and CSS, so I’m used to making sites look polished, function smoothly, and stay easy to maintain.

A couple of projects that reflect my approach:
- Embedded customer analytics: I built usage dashboards embedded in a SaaS product so each customer account saw its own metrics, and it was rolled out to 140 customer accounts.
- Multilingual documentation site: I built a docs site in 4 languages with instant search, and support tickets went down 27%.

While those projects were not WordPress e-commerce builds specifically, they show the kind of careful implementation, layout sensitivity, and fast turnaround I bring to web work. I’m comfortable working on site refreshes where the priority is to improve presentation, keep the process efficient, and avoid unnecessary complexity.

For your project, I would focus on:
- Connecting the new domain correctly
- Updating product images consistently
- Making small layout improvements for a cleaner, fresher storefront
- Checking responsiveness so the site still looks good on different screen sizes

I can work quickly, communicate clearly, and stay focused on the practical outcome you need. If you’re looking for someone who can get this done promptly and with attention to detail, I’d be glad to help.
